- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant stated that depictions of AI have evolved significantly over the past several decades, reflecting society's changing attitudes towards technology.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Earlier depictions of AI, such as in films like *2001: A Space Odyssey* (1968) and *Blade Runner* (1982), portrayed AI as either a helpful tool or a dangerous adversary.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Dystopian depictions of AI reflected society's concerns about technology outpacing human control.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] More recent depictions, such as in *Westworld* (2016) and *Ex Machina* (2014), portray AI as sentient and self-aware, raising ethical questions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The film *Her* (2013) explores the potential benefits of AI, depicting it as a helpful part of daily life.
- [USER] User found it fascinating how society's attitude towards AI has changed and asked if AI could ever become truly sentient and self-aware like in *Westworld*.
